verdict.rationale: ImageMagick's own docs describe a "scripting-first design for mass batch jobs" and an official CLI, and its multi-image operations (montage, animated sequences from frames) work on many inputs at once. A community user confirms scripting it to scale and center thousands of images. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of native bulk-processing mechanics (e.g., in-place batch commands or wildcard/glob input handling), and evidence of bulk processing that doesn't depend on external shell loops.
